requirements.title: Photo Requirements
requirements.heading: Quick tips for flawless
requirements.description: Better photo quality and more variety lead to better headshots. Natural lighting and relaxed expressions make all the difference.

sideHeading.tips: Follow these photo tips for better results
sideHeading.dodonts: What works well and what doesn't

tips.naturalLight: Use natural light by standing near a window or going outside.
tips.photos: Include both close-up and waist-up photos.
tips.expression: Keep your expression neutral or naturally friendly.
tips.avoid: Avoid filters, hats, heavy makeup, or AI-generated images.
tips.clothing: Wear plain clothing with solid colors or soft patterns.
tips.quantity: Upload <highlight>{{minImages}} to {{maxImages}}</highlight> different photos with varied angles and lighting.

requirements.tipBox: Natural light, facial variety, and clear framing help the AI create more accurate, professional results.

dodonts.eyes: Look at the camera with your eyes clearly visible.
dodonts.lighting: Use bright, natural lighting. Avoid dark or blurry photos.
dodonts.frame: Make sure you're alone in the frame, with no clutter or other people.
dodonts.face: Frame your face so it's not too small or cut off.
